caption: The drawing depicts a single, centrally positioned vessel with a wide, outwardly flared rim and a tapering body that narrows downward before gently curving outward again near the rounded base. The vessel is rendered in shades of gray, achieved through meticulous shading to suggest volume and depth. The body of the vessel features subtle horizontal bands. The drawing appears on a lightly tinted, off-white paper and is enclosed within a fine rectangular border. In the bottom left corner, there is a scaled-down technical sketch of the same vessel, showing a simple line drawing with dimensions indicated: a top diameter of 11 inches, a height of 9 inches, and a bottom diameter of 6 3/4 inches. The artist’s name is inscribed in the lower right corner.
title: Pewter Commode Form
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
